name: Tenaron Stormgrip
summary: High in Aldrassil, Tenaron Stormgrip guides young night elves through their people's recent history. He also asks them to gather water from a moonwell.

sections.title: Watcher of Aldrassil
sections.body: Tenaron Stormgrip guides young night elves on Aldrassil's winding wooden platforms. From high in Shadowglen's central tree, he watches the local woods and their moonwells. He teaches novices about their spiritual bond with the World Tree.

sections.title: Crown of the Earth
sections.body: Tenaron sends initiates to gather a phial of water from the moonwell north of Aldrassil. Along the way, he teaches them what followed the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Their journey carries on through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.

faq.answer: Tenaron Stormgrip stands on the wooden platforms high in Aldrassil, the central tree of Shadowglen in Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is Tenaron Stormgrip's role in Shadowglen?
faq.answer: Tenaron Stormgrip guides young night elves in Shadowglen and teaches them about the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal.

faq.q: What is the Crown of the Earth quest?
faq.answer: Tenaron asks initiates to gather moonwell water in a phial. The journey teaches them recent night elf history and continues across Teldrassil.

faq.q: Why is Tenaron concerned about Teldrassil's waters?
faq.answer: Tenaron watches Teldrassil's waters because its moonwells are vessels of Elune's grace and natural purity. Since Teldrassil is young and lacks the full blessing of the Aspects, caretakers monitor its water sources for corruption or taint.

faq.q: Does Tenaron send adventurers beyond Shadowglen?
faq.answer: Yes. Tenaron sends initiates beyond Shadowglen to Dolanaar, where they can continue serving the kaldorei.

faq.q: Is Tenaron a druid or a priest?
faq.answer: Tenaron's class is not established. He teaches recent night elf history and explains the significance of moonwells.

angles.text: For young night elves, Tenaron Stormgrip offers an early lesson in the communal and spiritual duties of keeping Teldrassil alive and pure.
As a druid, you can see in Tenaron's tasks the care needed to watch over Teldrassil's rapid growth and guard against subtle corruption.
